nodes.titleZh: 現在完成式：經驗與結果
nodes.titleEn: Present Perfect for Experience and Result
nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 用 have/has + 過去分詞表達到現在為止的經驗或目前相關結果。

naturalExamples.text: I have visited Japan twice.
She has never eaten sushi.
Have you ever seen a whale?
We have finished our project.

wrong.text: Did you ever visited Japan?

better.text: Have you ever visited Japan?

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 詢問到目前為止的經驗，使用 have + 過去分詞。

wrong.text: I have went there twice.

better.text: I have gone there twice.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: go 的過去分詞是 gone。

wrong.text: I saw that movie three times in my life.

better.text: I have seen that movie three times.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 未限定已結束時間、強調到目前的累積經驗，現在完成式較自然。

wrong.text: She has finish it.

better.text: She has finished it.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: has 後使用過去分詞 finished。

nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 用 already、yet、since、for 清楚表達完成與持續時間。
nodes.form: already in affirmative; yet in questions/negatives; since point; for duration

naturalExamples.text: I have already finished my homework.
She hasn't called yet.
We have lived here since 2022.
He has studied English for three years.

wrong.text: I have lived here since three years.

better.text: I have lived here for three years.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 三年是一段期間，使用 for。

wrong.text: I have finished my homework yesterday.

better.text: I finished my homework yesterday.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 明確已結束的 yesterday 通常使用過去簡單式。

chineseTransferBugs.zh: 我們從星期一就一直很忙。

wrong.text: We have been busy for Monday.

better.text: We have been busy since Monday.

wrong.text: Did you eat yet?

better.text: Have you eaten yet?

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 詢問到現在是否已完成，在標準學習語境用現在完成式。

acceptableVariants.noteZh: 美式口語可用過去式搭 yet；正式分級先掌握現在完成式。

nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 依時間是否已結束、是否與現在相關選擇時態。
nodes.form: finished time: past; life experience/current result: present perfect

naturalExamples.text: I visited London in 2024.
I have visited London three times.
She lost her keys yesterday.
She has lost her keys, so she can't open the door.

wrong.text: I have met him last Friday.

better.text: I met him last Friday.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: last Friday 是明確結束的過去時間。

wrong.text: I went to Japan three times in my life.

better.text: I have been to Japan three times.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 未結束的人生經驗通常用現在完成式更自然。

wrong.text: He has moved here in 2019.

better.text: He moved here in 2019.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 明確過去年份搭配過去簡單式。

chineseTransferBugs.zh: 我的鉛筆不見了，所以現在不能寫。

wrong.text: I lost my pencil, so I can't write now.

better.text: I have lost my pencil, so I can't write now.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 若強調目前仍找不到，可用現在完成式表現在結果；原句在部分語境仍可接受。

nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 用 if + 現在式和 will/can 表達真實可能的未來條件與結果。
nodes.form: if + present simple, will/can + base verb

naturalExamples.text: If it rains, we will stay inside.
If you study, you will learn more.
I will call you if I need help.
If we leave now, we can catch the bus.

wrong.text: If it will rain, we will stay inside.

better.text: If it rains, we will stay inside.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 第一條件句的 if 子句通常使用現在簡單式。

wrong.text: If you will study, you pass the test.

better.text: If you study, you will have a better chance of passing the test.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 條件與結果的形式要完整，且避免把結果說得不合理地絕對。

chineseTransferBugs.zh: 如果你早點睡，明天會感覺好一點。

wrong.text: If you will sleep early, you feel better tomorrow.

better.text: If you sleep early, you will feel better tomorrow.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: if 子句用現在式，結果使用 will。

chineseTransferBugs.zh: 如果我們錯過公車，可以走路。

wrong.text: If we miss the bus, we can to walk.

better.text: If we miss the bus, we can walk.

nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 用 who、which、that、where 把必要資訊連到正確的人、物或地點。

naturalExamples.text: The girl who won the race is my sister.
This is the book that I borrowed.
We built a machine which saves water.
The park where we play is nearby.

wrong.text: The girl which won the race is my sister.

better.text: The girl who won the race is my sister.

wrong.text: This is the book who I borrowed.

better.text: This is the book that I borrowed.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 指物時使用 that 或 which。

chineseTransferBugs.zh: 那位幫我的老師很親切。

wrong.text: The teacher which helped me is kind.

better.text: The teacher who helped me is kind.

chineseTransferBugs.zh: 這是我們見面的咖啡店。

wrong.text: This is the café which we met.

better.text: This is the café where we met.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 要表達在該地點發生，使用 where。

acceptableVariants.noteZh: 限定物件子句中 that、which 或省略受詞關係代名詞都可能自然。

nodes.titleZh: 反身代名詞與清楚指涉
nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 在主詞與受詞同一人時使用反身代名詞，並避免代名詞指涉含糊。
nodes.form: subject acts on self; intensive self for emphasis

naturalExamples.text: I made the card myself.
She hurt herself while running.
They introduced themselves.
Ben told Leo that Ben would lead the team.

wrong.text: Myself made the card.

better.text: I made the card myself.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: myself 不能取代普通主詞 I。

wrong.text: Please give the form to myself.

better.text: Please give the form to me.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 主詞不是同一人時，普通受詞使用 me。

wrong.text: He looked at him in the mirror.

better.text: He looked at himself in the mirror.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 主詞與受詞是同一個人，使用 himself。

chineseTransferBugs.zh: Tom 告訴 Ben 他會當隊長。

wrong.text: Tom told Ben that he would be the leader.

better.text: Tom told Ben that Tom would be the leader.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 原句的 he 可能指 Tom 或 Ben；必要時重複名字消除歧義。
